schema.stage_option.group.criteria: How it meets the stage criteria
schema.stage_option.stage_ref.label: Which stage is this for?
schema.stage_option.stage_ref.help: Pick one stage of the plan. It is named by its short name.
schema.stage_option.option_statement.lab: What is your option, in one or two sentences?
schema.stage_option.option_statement.hel: Say what would be done and for whom. One option per entry.
schema.stage_option.mechanism.label: How would it work?
schema.stage_option.mechanism.help: The steps that turn the action into the result.
schema.stage_option.responsible_role.hel: A role such as an office or a team. Never a named person.
schema.stage_option.authority_and_legal_: The rule, budget line or mandate that makes it lawful.
schema.stage_option.cost_estimate.band.l: About how much would it cost?
schema.stage_option.cost_estimate.band.h: Pick a band. Pick unknown if you cannot tell.
schema.stage_option.cost_estimate.amount: Your best number, if you have one
Optional and never exact. Leave it empty if unsure.
schema.stage_option.cost_estimate.label: What would it cost?
schema.stage_option.cost_estimate.help: A band is enough. A number is optional.
schema.stage_option.funding.label: Who would pay?
schema.stage_option.funding.help: The budget, grant or in-kind help it would come from.
schema.stage_option.how_it_meets_stage_c: The number of a criterion of this stage.
A check someone else could make.
How would it meet each criterion?
Pick a criterion by its number and say how anyone could tell the option meets it.
schema.stage_option.risks_and_rights_imp: What could go wrong, and who could be affected?
Include effects on people's rights, such as privacy or access.
Other lawful ways to reach the same goal
schema.stage_option.dependencies.label: What must happen first?
schema.stage_option.dependencies.help: Other things this option needs. Leave empty if none.
schema.stage_option.assumptions.label: What are you assuming?
schema.stage_option.assumptions.help: Saying what you take for granted lets others check it.
